items.title: Putin rules out partial ceasefire talks after Crimean Bridge strikes
items.summary: President Vladimir Putin said Russia had considered ceasefires in certain areas but would no longer negotiate those arrangements following attacks on the Crimean Bridge. He warned of a much more painful Russian response and said the bridge would be restored; he also claimed it was not being used to transport military equipment.

items.title: Putin says Moscow accepted US compromise proposals on Ukraine
items.summary: Putin said Russia had accepted compromise ideas presented by the United States during talks in Anchorage, but argued Ukraine and European governments were not yet prepared to agree. He also claimed Ukraine's leadership had little incentive to stop fighting because elections and foreign funding would be at stake.

items.title: Three killed in Ukrainian attack on Russia's Saratov region, report says
items.summary: A Russian report said three people were killed and one injured during a Ukrainian attack in Saratov region. Civilian infrastructure was reportedly damaged, and authorities warned that the threat of further strikes remained.

items.title: Russia reports 130 vessels switched to its flag amid sanctions pressure
items.summary: Russian Transport Minister Dmitry Yadrov reportedly said more than 130 vessels had switched to the Russian flag since June 2026, bringing the registered fleet to 4,980 ships. The report linked the trend partly to sanctions-related pressure on shipping and described registration reforms intended to attract more vessels.

items.title: Ukraine reportedly proposes Taiwanese fleet of 5,500 unmanned sea vessels
items.summary: A report says Ukraine proposed that Taiwan stockpile 5,500 unmanned surface vessels in dispersed, hardened storage sites to prepare for a possible conflict with China. The proposed vessels would be intended to disrupt amphibious landing ships and naval logistics; no Taiwanese adoption of the proposal was reported.
